summary: Owlet, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to postpone its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders from July 10, 2026 to August 12, 2026 due to scheduling conflicts, with a new record date of June 15, 2026. The filing also resets deadlines for stockholder proposals under Rule 14a-8 and bylaw requirements. No special-situation event is present—the filing is a routine administrative scheduling change for an annual meeting. No deal terms, advisor, or strategic action applies. Watch only for any subsequent stockholder proposals submitted by the new deadline.
